code:
import Mathlib
import Aesop

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem gcd_divides_both (p a b : ℕ) : p ∣ Nat.gcd a b → p ∣ a ∧ p ∣ b := by
  intro h
  have h₁ : p ∣ Nat.gcd a b := h
  have h₂ : p ∣ a := by
    -- Since p divides gcd(a, b), and gcd(a, b) divides a, by transitivity, p divides a.
    exact Nat.dvd_trans h₁ (Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b)
  have h₃ : p ∣ b := by
    -- Similarly, since p divides gcd(a, b), and gcd(a, b) divides b, by transitivity, p divides b.
    exact Nat.dvd_trans h₁ (Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b)
  exact ⟨h₂, h₃⟩
